slowCaseAttribution.scope: single completed default VeryHigh Ironclad elite A/B pair; descriptive attribution only

outcome.qualityAndRoute: reported equal; 2 potions used in each
outcome.memberDiagnostics: Only member 0 ran in each arm, but member skip reasons differ: A MemoryHeadroomInsufficient; B BaselineTimeShareExceeded. Do not characterize complete member signatures as identical.

interpretation.finding: The B arm's 295 added between_turn_layers checkpoints accumulated 74771.3 ms of checkpoint elapsed time. Total checkpoint elapsed increased by 60484.1 ms while request wall time increased by 79556.0 ms; this is a strong aggregate association and accounts for much of the observed regression in this one pair.
limits: Checkpoint elapsed is aggregate time spent in checkpoint calls; available records do not isolate collection, NoGC-region restart/rebuild, coordination, or other internal costs.

The approximately 253.5 ms mean for between_turn_layers must not be attributed to a fixed delay. The 250 ms ReclaimReferenceReleaseDelay is post-search only and does not apply to this in-search checkpoint path.
GC pause deltas sum to only 5.331 s in A and 3.646 s in B, so GC pause alone does not explain the B wall-time increase.
This is one completed root pair, not a multi-scene result or causal intervention.

limitations: Single pair per root/platform, not a significance estimate.
Offline performance only; no visible Steam/FPS claim.
Configured default budget; actual Windows NoGC size follows available memory.
Complete controller and Fork fixtures still have explicitly documented failures.
No claim of an additional 20% speed or decision-quality improvement.
